subject: [RFC PATCH 31/57] mm/khugepaged: count collapses where khugepaged makes them

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged code to count page collapses within its own walk, rather than relying on the caller to update a shared counter. This simplifies the code and eliminates unnecessary checks for whether the collapse is being performed by the khugepaged daemon or not. The change prepares the way for moving the dispatcher into a separate file from where it can access static variables in khugepaged.c.
